CONTEXT: A PR replaces the base SFCC `DisplayPrice` with a custom `ZimmProductPrice` atom inside `overrides/app/components/item-variant/item-price.tsx` for discounted cart lines. The base `DisplayPrice` passed `labelForA11y={variant?.name}` which rendered a `<VisuallyHidden aria-live="polite" aria-atomic>` node containing the product name followed by "current price $X" / "original price $Y". The override's new branch drops that entirely.

I need to know whether the product NAME is still programmatically associated with the PRICE in the surrounding DOM of a cart line item, by any other means.

TASKS (quote exact `file:line` for everything):

1. List every file under `overrides/app/components/item-variant/` and `overrides/app/components/product-item/`. For each, report whether it exists as an override or only in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/`.

2. Read `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/index.jsx`, `item-name.jsx`, `item-attributes.jsx`, `item-image.jsx` and any other files in that folder. Report the DOM structure each produces (tags, aria-*, role, id/htmlFor/aria-labelledby/aria-describedby).

3. Read `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/index.jsx`. Report the full DOM/markup structure of a cart line item: what wraps `ItemPrice`, what wraps `ItemName`, is there any `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `role="group"`, `<li>`, heading, or table semantics tying name to price? Is `ItemPrice` inside the same accessible-name-computation scope as the item name?

4. Find every CALLER of `item-variant/item-price` (both the base path `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-price` and any relative import). Search all of `overrides/` AND all of `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`. List each caller file:line and say what surface it is (cart page, cart drawer, checkout confirmation, wishlist, account order history, bonus product modal, etc.). This tells me the blast radius of the override.

5. Specifically check: does the repo have an override at `overrides/app/components/product-item/` at all? And does `overrides/app/pages/cart/` (any file, including cartDrawerContainer / cart drawer / zimmCartItem*) render its own cart line markup that bypasses base `product-item`? If so, report that markup's structure and whether it renders `ItemPrice` at all, and whether IT associates name with price.

6. Check whether anything in `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/**` named like zimmCartItem / cartItem renders prices, and if so via which component.

Return a factual report with file:line citations. Be explicit about what you could not find and what search patterns you used.
